narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>The centre of the square is on one of its sides, so the compass point goes there.
<bookmark mark='circle'/>Draw a circle from the middle of a side, and half of it falls outside the board.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>A hole must sit inside the square, so its centre cannot lie on a side.

narration: <bookmark mark='rule'/>To put a circle in the middle of a square, draw both diagonals and use their crossing point.
<bookmark mark='turn'/>Your turn. A square has side twelve centimetres.
<bookmark mark='ask'/>Where must the compass point go to draw a circle with the same centre?
